foundations.name: Foundations & pretraining
foundations.description: From one token to a training recipe you can justify.

systems.name: Training & inference systems
systems.description: Understand how tensors are distributed, computed, and recovered reliably.

agents.name: Post-training & agents
agents.description: Turn feedback into updates and verify capabilities with independent evaluation.

loss.title: One loss denominator connects data, distributed training, and RL
loss.text: Packing and loss masks change the valid-token count. When shards contain different numbers of valid targets, averaging local means changes the global token-weighted objective. RL trajectories also need an explicit weighting unit.
loss.evidence: The grouping counterexample has been checked in a CPU experiment. Distributed and RL execution remain to be verified.

data.title: Data identity makes experiments interpretable
data.text: Data sources, tokenizer, processing versions, packing, and the actual mixture must be recorded with a run to distinguish improvements caused by the recipe, budget, or data.
data.evidence: A synthesis of public recipes and data-artifact contracts.

recovery.title: Tensor placement determines how training can recover
recovery.text: The parallel layout determines ownership of parameters and optimizer state. Recovery also requires master weights when used by the training configuration, random-number-generator state, data position, and a complete checkpoint commit.
recovery.evidence: Synthesized from pinned source code and public case studies. Bitwise equivalence after recovery under a different topology has not been verified.

moe.title: MoE communication layout is a kernel input contract
moe.text: Routing groups tokens into expert-aligned rows. Kernels consume this layout, and the reverse routing step restores and aggregates outputs. Metadata, streams, and buffer lifetimes affect correctness and performance.
moe.evidence: Specific adapters are supported by source evidence. Different DeepEP interface versions are not interchangeable.

reward.title: How does task feedback become a training objective?
reward.text: Environment feedback needs explicit reward dimensions and scalarization rules. Trajectories must also preserve action tokens, log probabilities, masks, branches, and versions to support correct updates.
reward.evidence: A focused CPU experiment checked the Python reward assertions. Harbor reward loading and end-to-end training integration remain unverified.

policy.title: Design generation throughput and policy consistency together
policy.text: Weight handoff requires a complete policy version and alignment of the tokenizer, template, routing, precision, and sampling. Policy staleness, numerical differences, and reuse of old KV-cache entries need separate diagnosis.
policy.evidence: A synthesis of semantics across system layers. Independently pinned repositories are not a validated compatible stack.

context.title: Longer context requires checking the entire pipeline again
context.text: Longer context changes sample organization, expert load, memory use, and communication. These changes affect rollout duration, the KV cache, queue staleness, and recovery cost.
context.evidence: Complementary examples from public implementations. A threshold from one system should not be generalized to every system.
